activity.notes: 1837 is the Institution of Civil Engineers-dated Great Western steamship design/build representative point, not a full career or claim that Brunel invented the first suspension bridge. His Great Western Railway chief-engineer role, bridges, broad-gauge railway and death before 1864 Clifton Bridge completion are independently documented. Do not conflate with his father Marc Isambard Brunel.
